id: title:GeneralistDev:emit logged in when a simulated user logs back in

observations.behavior: Changes the reset behavior of a demo backend client to set logged-in status to false instead of true.
observations.posthog_connection: This is an isolated change within a dedicated demo product path; it does not affect PostHog's core identity or authentication systems.

observations.behavior: Adds two new event constants related to login and logout actions into the demo taxonomy.
observations.posthog_connection: These are local definitions used only by this specific demo simulation, with no indication they replace or extend PostHog's existing super-properties or standard events.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test asserting that simulated users produce both logout and login events in their history.
observations.posthog_connection: The test validates internal consistency of the HedgeboxMatrix demo, not correctness or reliability of PostHog's production ingestion or query paths.

observations.limitations: All changes reside exclusively under products/demo/, which is clearly separated from PostHog's shared services. No evidence shows these modifications propagate to customer-facing features, shared models, or critical infrastructure.
